baseline_disposition.notes: F-040/F-041 fixed (code-verified; spacing/motion not measurable in static capture but rendering is consistent with the claim). F-010 chip itself is occluded by the offline toast in every capture (see F-102); verdict rests on token_contrast showing 0 AA failures and no gold text anywhere.

findings.evidence: Unchanged from baseline: START SVG PRINT renders filled-accent directly beside 'No SVG selected' (setup_verify.png); PRINT IMAGE filled while 'No image selected' (create_image.png); SAVE TO BANK filled while 'No picture selected' (create_motif.png). Nothing signals the action cannot succeed until pressed.
findings.recommendation: Disable (dim) prerequisite-gated primaries with the reason in tooltip/adjacent helper; enable on valid input.

findings.evidence: The toast moved from bottom to top as claimed, so it no longer covers REFRESH PREVIEW or the sliders — but it now floats over the top bar itself (x~330-955, y0-70; dump.json DISMISS 89x32 @857,22): it fully hides the machine-state chip on every view, hides the workspace sub-tab row on SETUP (PEN/SHEET/VERIFY/ADVANCED unreadable behind it, setup_machine.png) and CREATE (TEXTURE..MOTIF, create_image.png), and half-covers SEND on PRINT ('?END' at 923,40, print.png). The occlusion moved from content to primary navigation plus the one state indicator the fix was meant to surface. The PRINT bottom status line 'Uploaded SVG finished: TEXT ZZBVFNTL' is still clipped at y=794 of the 800px overflow-hidden viewport (print.png).
findings.measurement: dump.json: DISMISS @(857,22) on all 3 views; SETUP sub-tabs start x=238 y=40, toast spans past x=955; PRINT status row at y>=794
findings.recommendation: Reserve a banner strip below the top bar that reflows content (or shrink the toast to the free area right of the tabs); never overlay the chip or nav; fix the PRINT bottom strip so no status sits below the fold.

findings.evidence: New with the neutral theme: the DISMISS action on the persistent offline toast renders in ACCENT blue #2F5A8F on the toast's DANGER red #A0221A fill — 1.09:1, essentially invisible (print.png, every view). The only control that clears the app's most persistent overlay fails WCAG by an order of magnitude; the theme seeds Quasar notify actions with the accent color regardless of the notification background.
findings.measurement: Sampled pixels: DISMISS glyphs #2F5A8F on #A0221A = 1.09:1 (AA needs 4.5:1); darkest anti-aliased pixel #6D3B4E = 1.15:1
findings.recommendation: Set notify action color to the notification's on-color (SURFACE #F7F8FA on DANGER = 7.22:1, already AA per token_contrast); add a render test that samples toast action contrast.

findings.screen: Left rail Manual motion (all views) + top-bar chip
findings.evidence: Fixed parts verified: Next action now reads 'Connect the plotter first: SETUP → MACHINE → CONNECT.' and blockers lead with 'plotter offline' (dump.json, all views). Still open: Manual motion captions 'Blocked while G-code streams.' identically on all views while the plotter is offline and nothing streams, with jog/PEN/HOME buttons rendered enabled (dump.json/print.png); the chip's claimed OFFLINE state cannot be confirmed because the toast covers it in every capture (F-102).
findings.measurement: dump.json: 'Blocked while G-code streams.' identical on PRINT/CREATE/SETUP; jog buttons enabled offline
findings.recommendation: Make the Manual motion caption state-driven ('Offline — connect on SETUP first' / 'Blocked: G-code streaming' / 'Ready') and disable jog controls when they cannot act.

findings.evidence: Improved: STOP SYSTEM is now filled danger red vs START SYSTEM filled accent blue — the destructive action finally looks different (print.png); scope tooltips are claimed but not visible in static captures. Still open: four stop-family labels remain (EMERGENCY STOP, STOP PRINT, STOP SYSTEM, RESET / ABORT) with no on-screen scope text, so the one-emergency-decision problem persists at the naming level.
findings.measurement: dump.json PRINT: STOP PRINT @993,3, EMERGENCY STOP @1122,4, STOP SYSTEM @1009,197; SETUP adds RESET / ABORT
findings.recommendation: Rename to outcome-based labels with one-line consequence text visible (not tooltip-only); keep one solid emergency action.

findings.evidence: STOP PRINT (outline danger, 97x34 @993,3) and EMERGENCY STOP (filled danger, 148x32 @1122,4) now have distinct visual weights, but the gap is still 32px (1090→1122) in the same top-right cluster; a corner-directed miss still lands on the e-stop.
findings.recommendation: Move STOP PRINT context-local to PRINT's System run card; leave EMERGENCY STOP alone in the corner.

findings.evidence: The toast detail line still leaks raw developer output: 'FluidNC Telnet offline: :23; HTTP offline ([Errno 61] Connection refused)' (print.png), and on SETUP/MACHINE the same line is still truncated with no expand: 'FluidNC Telnet offline: :23; HTTP offline ([Errno 61] Co…' (setup_machine.png). Only the toast position changed.
findings.measurement: Visible ':23' bare port + Python errno on every view
findings.recommendation: Move protocol detail behind an expandable 'details' affordance, phrased 'Control channel (telnet, port 23): unreachable'.

findings.evidence: Comma decimals persist in inputs against dot-decimal readouts: 'Pen width mm 0,3' (setup_pen.png); CLAMP helper '0.25 to 3 mm' above field '0,25' (setup_advanced.png); 'Dot mm 1,5' (setup_sheet.png); 'Cell mm 0,1' (create_image.png); '0,8'/'1,5'/'0,4' (create_motif.png) vs 'Origin X/Y: 25.0 / 25.0 mm'.
findings.measurement: Comma-formatted ui.number inputs adjacent to dot-formatted computed text on 5 screens
findings.recommendation: Pin display formatting to dot-decimal app-wide; accept both on input.

findings.evidence: 'Image folder' is still a free-text server path field with no picker, no placeholder example, no validation feedback; the stray '-' still dangles under the Travel lines toggle (create_sheet.png @~945,458).
findings.recommendation: Folder picker or recent-folders dropdown; validate on blur with 'found N images'; hide the empty '-' stats line.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: the rendered 'NEJE ORACLE' preview is still a small box pinned to the canvas's top-left with the leftmost glyph stems clipped at the panel edge (flow_text_preview.png, create_text.png); placement/size on the sheet cannot be judged.
findings.measurement: Preview ~227x98px at canvas origin inside ~686x670px canvas; left glyphs cut off
findings.recommendation: Fit-and-center the generated preview at its actual origin/scale, matching SKETCH/TEXTURE behavior.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: Font selector still displays the internal identifier 'zzBVFNTL' (create_text.png, dump.json).
findings.recommendation: Human-readable font names, ideally rendered in their own face.

findings.evidence: One class still carries guidance and live state: 'blockers: plotter offline · work zero · print paused', 'Not ready', and 'Blocked while G-code streams.' are all .oracle-helper 12px, identical to instructional captions (dump.json, all views) — now in neutral grey instead of rust, but still indistinguishable from commentary; WARN/DANGER text tokens remain unused for state.
findings.measurement: dump.json: all three state strings class=oracle-helper, fs=12px
findings.recommendation: Render live blockers/readiness in WARN or DANGER with an icon; keep grey for guidance.

findings.evidence: Multi-line procedure text is still 12px: the 3-line Z-tune procedure (setup_pen.png), the 2-paragraph pen-calibration procedure (setup_verify.png), the 4-line motif guidance (create_motif.png). measurements.json font_sizes_in_view = [12px,13px,14px] on all views; nothing >=16px. (Line length is now fixed — F-024.)
findings.measurement: measurements.json: max font size 14px on every view
findings.recommendation: Raise multi-line procedure text to 14-16px; keep 12px for single-line captions.

findings.screen: Left rail SET WORK ZERO (all views)
findings.evidence: New with the intent-helper sweep: SET WORK ZERO renders as a filled DANGER button (#A0221A) identical to STOP SYSTEM and RESET / ABORT (print.png, all views). A routine calibration step now wears the same uniform as the destructive stops — on PRINT four danger-red surfaces are visible at once (EMERGENCY STOP, SET WORK ZERO, STOP SYSTEM, the toast), diluting exactly the danger signal the F-001 fix established.
findings.measurement: Sampled fill #A0221A (= DANGER token) on SET WORK ZERO, STOP SYSTEM, RESET / ABORT, EMERGENCY STOP, toast
findings.recommendation: If SET WORK ZERO is destructive (overwrites zero), use the outline danger variant; if routine, use the accent primary. Reserve filled danger for motion-stopping actions only.

findings.evidence: Guidance added: '30 per sheet. Point "Image folder" at a folder of images.' now explains the empty sheet (create_sheet.png). The bare '-' status still renders beneath the Travel lines toggle.
findings.recommendation: Hide the '-' stats line until there is a stat to show.

findings.evidence: The sev-3 core is fixed: Pen lifts now shows a computed 'off' badge at max and the helper reads a real sentence (create_image.png). Residual: the quality slider's 'fine' badge still drops onto its helper sentence, covering '…allow m[ore se]gments'.
findings.recommendation: Offset slider badges above the track so they never cover helper text.

findings.evidence: Mostly fixed: 'Feed mm/min', 'Field W mm', 'Field H mm', 'Gap mm', 'Margin mm', 'Dot mm' now carry units (setup_sheet.png, dump.json). Residual: 'Cell 80' (setup_sheet.png) and 'SVG X0'/'SVG Y0' (setup_verify.png) are still unitless.
findings.recommendation: Finish the sweep: 'Cell mm', 'SVG X0 mm', 'SVG Y0 mm'.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: every parameter tweak still needs an explicit REFRESH PREVIEW press (flow_text_preview.png; button present on all CREATE tabs); previews are not marked stale.
findings.measurement: text-preview flow: 1 of 3 steps is the manual refresh
findings.recommendation: Debounce-auto-refresh or mark the preview stale on parameter change.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: ~13 controls in one flat group (create_motif.png); still the densest view (measurements.json: 41 interactive).
findings.recommendation: Chunk into Crop / Trace / Save sub-sections.

findings.evidence: The chip still uses a bordered-pill treatment per code; not directly assessable in this run because the toast covers it in every capture (see F-102) — which itself demonstrates the chip's fragility as the primary state readout.
findings.recommendation: Restyle as a non-interactive filled badge; guarantee nothing can overlay it.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: 'Require Firebase' one-click global toggle in persistent chrome (dump.json: q-toggle 164x40 @503,0), no confirmation, consequences unstated.
findings.recommendation: Move to SETUP or require confirm; show active mode as read-only chip.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: 'FAIL/SKIP 0 / 177' merged tile with unexplained denominator, caption 'Queue counts loaded', log-styled blockers line (print.png, dump.json).
findings.recommendation: Split FAIL and SKIP tiles with drill-down; drop 'Queue counts loaded'.

findings.evidence: Unchanged: origin labels at x=251, Preview checkboxes at ~x=598, Print checkboxes at ~x=936 — ~350px gaps across five identical rows with no row rules (setup_advanced.png).
findings.recommendation: Tighten columns or add hairline row separators / hover band.

findings.evidence: Near-miss offsets persist after the spacing sweep: edges 80/81, 85/86, 238/240 recur on every view; SETUP/PEN adds 249/251, 261/263, 399/402, 402/404; CREATE/MOTIF adds 1065/1068, 1092/1093, 1122/1125 (measurements.json alignment_near_misses).
findings.measurement: measurements.json: 3 recurring 1-2px offsets on all 14 views, up to 7 on SETUP/PEN
findings.recommendation: One shared padding/inset token for rail cards and field labels.

findings.evidence: The neutral-theme sweep missed the texture editor: its toolbar renders legacy cream/rust pill buttons (+ Add, Delete, Set as output, Reseed, Save) and two native browser <select> elements ('perlin', 'load…') that match neither the intent-button system nor Quasar (create_texture.png). The cream node canvas may be intentional paper, but the toolbar is UI chrome in last run's palette.
findings.measurement: 5 off-system pill buttons + 2 native selects in one toolbar
findings.recommendation: Restyle the toolbar with intent helpers and q-selects; decide explicitly whether the node canvas keeps the paper palette.
